canonicalIngredients.name: dried porcini mushrooms
observations: 10 g, rehydrated in 125 ml boiling water, soaking liquid used (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: parmesan cheese
observations: 1 cup / 80 g Parmigiano Reggiano, extra to serve (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: fresh thyme
observations: 4 sprigs with mushrooms, extra to serve (s0)

causalSequence: heat stock; hold at gentle simmer in second pan
saute mushrooms in hot fat, minimal stirring, until browned; set aside
soften onion (and garlic) in oil ~5 min
add rice; toast 1-3 min until coated and translucent
add hot stock 1/4-1 cup at a time, stirring; absorb between additions, ~20-25 min to al dente
off heat: stir in parmesan and most of the mushrooms; season
top with reserved mushrooms; rest ~5 min
techniqueFacts: all three cook mushrooms separately and fold in at the end to avoid overcooking
all three hold stock hot and add gradually with frequent stirring; done = al dente with slight bite, never mushy
two sources brown mushrooms over high-ish heat stirring only occasionally so they colour instead of steam
one source boosts flavour with rehydrated dried porcini plus its soaking liquid
one source finishes with lemon juice; one rests risotto covered 5 min off heat with a little liquid remaining
wine can be replaced with extra stock (one source)
vegetarian/GF hold needs vegetable stock: one source uses vegetable only, one lists chicken-or-vegetable, one uses chicken
one source offers a vegan variant (skip cheese); strict vegetarians need a non-animal-rennet parmesan-style cheese since Parmigiano Reggiano PDO is traditionally made
all three sources state serves 4-6; total time 45-60 min
arborio is the standard rice; carnaroli noted as creamier alternative (one source)
